text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Taiki Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Look at that machine! It's packed full of 
Umamusume toys!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Taiki Shuttle 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It says "Paka Petit"! Ahaha, it's so very 
cute!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If I send these souvenirs to my little 
sisters in America, they will surely be 
thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Really!? Thank you! I have high 
hopes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
